The Subtask Name: Determine the release years of Icehouse pieces and Kill Doctor Lucky.

Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Conducted internet searches to gather information on the release years of Icehouse pieces and Kill Doctor Lucky.
  -- Observation: Identified that Icehouse pieces were first released in 1989 with the "Martian Chess Set" and Kill Doctor Lucky was released in 1996.
  -- Thought: Compared the release years to determine which game came first.
  -- Result: Confirmed that Icehouse pieces were released first, in 1989, compared to Kill Doctor Lucky's release in 1996.
